newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate edges up to 5.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate edges up to 5.50 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills edged up to 5.50 percent from 5.49 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Tuesday.
The BMA was closed on Monday for a national holiday.
The average price was steady at 98.630 and the minimum price accepted was 98.629.
Banks submitted bids for 14.75 million dinars worth of bills, down from 24.7 million dinars the previous week.
